title: Summit Hackathon 2027
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 107 attendees for this Hackathon, in line with turnout at our previous Hackathon events.
The requested budget of INR 42,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Hackathon.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
